_readme: Per-route em dash budget for scripts/check-copy.mjs. The check FAILS if a route exceeds its number, so this can only ratchet down. Lower it with `node scripts/check-copy.mjs --update-budget` after each pass of copy edits. PARTIAL: baselined against a local build, which cannot reach Supabase or OpenWeather, so the four blog posts and the two air-quality routes are ABSENT and unguarded. Re-baseline against a real deployment (`--base https://www.glamrepairs.com`) to cover them — they hold most of the remaining em dashes.
